admission.justification: Binds the observer snapshot as a named open boundary: drift never writes it, and only explicit report producers keep both artifacts.

alternatives.option: The drift markdown report is gated behind existing output knobs with pointers omitted when unfiled; the observer snapshot still applies as the named open boundary returned for observer-scope design.
alternatives.reason: Writing the snapshot from drift would make every drift read a producer and preempt the observer-scope decision.

alternatives.option: Write the observer snapshot from drift reads.
alternatives.reason: Preempts the observer-scope design decision and makes every drift read a producer.
alternatives.reconsider_when: Observer scope is designed with a governed snapshot writer.

consequences: Future drift work keeps the snapshot untouched and the report gated.
context: Worker P15: drift snapshot untouched, returned as the first boundary needing observer-scope design.
